checks.detail: OS autostart is not installed. This is OPTIONAL and NOT blocking — the daemon runs fine for this session; autostart only makes the A2A service start automatically on every boot/logon so you don't have to start it manually. On Windows this needs an Administrator terminal.

fix.description: Optional: to start the A2A daemon automatically at every logon, run this once from an Administrator PowerShell. Skipping it is fine — just run `okx-a2a daemon start` when you need the daemon.
